title: Ashby Review (2026)
intro: Ashby is evaluated here as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform — Ashby is an all-in-one ATS with recruiting CRM, scheduling, and analytics, marketed from startups through enterprise. Foundations is $400/mo (≤100 employees; 10% off annual). Plus (101–1,000) and Enterprise (1,000+) are seat-based custom quotes. Foundations extras: SSO $100/mo, extra SMS, 1,500 AI credits/mo; AI Notetaker and Advanced Scheduling are paid add-ons without public dollars. No free plan. Analytics is also sold standalone for teams keeping another ATS. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Ashby when a modern AI-forward ATS with published Foundations pricing for ≤100 employees is the job — not when you need a free ATS, Greenhouse structured kits, or a core HRIS.
verdict: Choose Ashby when a modern AI-forward ATS with published Foundations pricing for ≤100 employees is the job — not when you need a free ATS, Greenhouse structured kits, or a core HRIS. Compare Greenhouse for structured hiring, Lever for ATS+CRM quotes, Workable for cheaper published floors, and Breezy HR for a free Bootstrap. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Startup-to-mid ATS with a published Foundations SKU is easier to start than Greenhouse quotes — still not a free Bootstrap. Not lab-tested.
Primary job is modern ATS/CRM/analytics. Scored inside ATS; Greenhouse keeps structured-hiring-kit excellence.
Scheduling, sourcing, and analytics in one ATS is deep. Held at 9 vs the most process-heavy enterprise TA suites.
Standard TA ecosystem connectors; MCP/AI tooling is the differentiator more than connector count.
Hiring-manager mobility is better than some enterprise ATS tools, still not WFM.
Native ATS analytics (and standalone Analytics SKU) are a published strength.
Foundations → Plus → Enterprise is clear; the 101-employee quote cliff is the friction.
$400/mo is a high SMB floor versus Breezy/Workable; add-ons raise TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Agents, credits, notetaker, and auto-scheduler are the most complete P2 ATS AI story — with credit/add-on packaging.

faq.answer: Yes. Ashby is evaluated as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform.

faq.question: How is Ashby priced?

faq.answer: No free plan is published. No free trial is documented on the pricing page. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Ashby?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
